scope: Proposition 8.4 of the manuscript “Midpoint lenses in segment spaces” (preprints/Midpoint-lenses-in-segment-spaces-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e5fa3ffa1ac9778a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose an infinite-dimensional real Banach space (Z, ∥ · ∥) contains, for every positive integer k, vectors (us)s∈N≤k such that 0 < m ≤ ∥us∥ ≤ M, ∥us⌢j − us∥ ≥ c > 0, where m, M, c are independent of k, and for each nonterminal s the sequence (us⌢j −us)j is weakly null against the whole continuous dual of Z. If 0 < a ≤ b < ∞ and a∥z∥ ≤ N(z) ≤ b∥z∥, then δN (︃ ac bM )︃ = 0. In particular the same conclusion holds at ac/(2bM), and Z admits no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm.
